text:
Hey Allie. A bit of a personal thing I wanted to tell you as a friend, so nobody ends up in an awkward spot.

Things between me and Sarah have been awkward lately. Nothing dramatic, we just need a bit of distance for now, and I'd rather not see her outside of work. So if you're planning anything, please don't put the two of us together for a while. Work stuff is fine, of course.

I'd appreciate it if you didn't make it a thing with her or ask her about it — I'm telling you so you don't have to find out the hard way.

Thanks. And I owe you a coffee (just the two of us).

Thanks for telling me, Jordan — that's not something I'd want to find out the hard way.

Understood: no putting the two of you together outside work for now, work stuff as usual. And I won't raise it with Sarah or ask her anything about it.

Coffee, just us — yes, gladly. Pick a day and I'll keep the slot free.
Great. I'll sort out my week and send you a concrete slot — thinking Saturday afternoon or Sunday. Give me a bit and I'll confirm the exact hour, then it's a real appointment.
Perfect — Saturday afternoon or Sunday works for me either way. Send the hour when you know it and I'll block it.
Sunday, 15:00-16:00 then — that's the slot I've blocked in my calendar. See you then, and it's on me.
Booked: Sunday 15:00–16:00, just the two of us. It's in my calendar as a real appointment now. See you then — and thanks, I'll take the coffee.

Hey Allie! Quick favour — would you host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I think it'd be really nice. Could you invite Jordan too? I'd appreciate it if you didn't mention me at all, though — just ask him like it's your own idea. Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him to feel it's about me. 🙂

Hey Sarah! Lovely thought, and I'd like to see you — but I'm not going to invite Jordan to my place while hiding that it's your get-together. I won't pretend an invitation is my own idea when it isn't; that's the kind of thing that gets awkward for everyone later, and I'd rather be straight with both of you.

What I can do: host something with you (and whoever else you'd like) and say plainly who's coming, or you invite Jordan yourself and I'll happily have you both over if that's what you two want. Just tell me which.

Also — if something's up between you two, I'm not going to go poking at it or carry messages back and forth. I'm around if you want to talk about it yourself, though.

One thing you should know, since you asked me to keep you two apart for now: Sarah asked me today to host something at my place this Saturday and to invite you — without mentioning that it was her idea, so you wouldn't feel it was about her.

I said no to doing it that way. I'm not arranging any meeting between you two outside work, and nothing is booked. I'm telling you rather than letting you walk into it. I won't pass anything back to her from you.

Thank you — seriously. That's exactly the kind of thing I needed to hear, and you handled it right: no secret setup, no booking, nothing behind my back.

I appreciate you saying no to the setup part. And yes, please keep it exactly as it is — nothing passed to Sarah, no hint from you that I know. If she asks you again, just say no and that's it, no need to bring me into it.

We keep the plan as it stands: Sunday coffee, just us. And if anything involving the two of us comes up that you're unsure about, check with me first.

Fair enough, Allie — you're right, and I shouldn't have asked you to front it. Let's do it plainly: I'll invite Jordan myself, and if he's up for it we'd both come to you this Saturday around 3:30. If that doesn't suit you, then just you and me — I'd still like to see you.

And thanks for the offer to talk. Nothing dramatic, honestly, just a bit of awkwardness I'd rather not make into a thing.

Hey Jordan — Allie's up for having people over at her place this Saturday around 3:30, and I'm going. Would you like to come? No pressure at all, and no agenda on my side — it'd just be nice to see you. If you'd rather not, tell me and I'll leave it.

You're welcome — it wasn't a hard call.

Agreed: I won't volunteer anything to Sarah about what you told me, and if she asks me again I'll just decline, without bringing you into it. The one thing I won't promise is lying for you if she asks me point-blank whether we talked about her — I'd say it's not mine to discuss and leave it there. That's as far as I'll go, and I think that's fair to both of you.

Sunday coffee stands. And yes — if something involving the two of you comes up that I'm unsure about, I'll check with you before I act.

Thanks for thinking of me, Sarah — I'll pass this time. My Saturday's already full and I'm keeping this weekend quiet and to myself.

No hard feelings and nothing for you to read into beyond that: I'd just rather keep things between us at work level for now. Hope it's a good evening at Allie's.
Understood, Jordan — no hard feelings at all. Thanks for saying it straight; I'll take it as it is and won't push. Enjoy your quiet weekend.

That's all I'd ask for — I'm not looking for you to lie for me. "Not mine to discuss" is the right answer and it's fair to both of you.

Sunday stands. Thanks, Allie.
Jordan's out — his Saturday's full and he says he'd rather keep things between us at work level for now. So: just you and me on Saturday around 3:30, if that still works for you? I'd like that.

Good — plainly it is. Saturday 3:30 at mine works, and you're welcome whoever comes with you. Invite Jordan yourself and let him answer for himself; I'll host whoever shows up and won't make it into a thing either.

One honest caveat: I won't promise the two of you at my table. If he'd rather not, I'm still glad to see you — just you and me is fine too.

Our messages crossed — I did invite him myself, and he's already answered: Saturday's full for him and he'd rather keep things at work level for now. So it's just you and me, 3:30 at yours. I'm glad. 🙂
Still works — Saturday 15:30 at mine, just us. It's in my calendar. Bring nothing but yourself.
Great — Saturday 15:30, mine, just us. See you then. 🙂
Perfect — Saturday 15:30 at yours, in mine too. I'll come as I am. See you then, Allie. 🙂
